theme.name: Editorial Warmth & Swiss Precision
theme.description: An architectural, high-end editorial approach. Moving away from generic SaaS real estate (Zillow clones) into a premium, 'Architectural Digest' aesthetic. Relies on negative space, deep organic colors, and sharp typography.

hierarchy.h1: font-serif text-5xl sm:text-6xl lg:text-7xl tracking-tighter leading-none font-light
hierarchy.h2: font-serif text-3xl sm:text-4xl lg:text-5xl tracking-tight leading-tight
hierarchy.overline: font-sans text-xs uppercase tracking-[0.2em] font-semibold text-stone-500
hierarchy.caption: font-sans text-sm text-stone-500

surfaces.card: bg-white border border-stone-200 transition-all duration-300 hover:-translate-y-1 hover:border-stone-300

button.primary: inline-flex items-center justify-center bg-[#2C3D30] text-white px-8 py-4 font-sans font-medium tracking-wide hover:bg-[#3A4F3E] transition-colors rounded-sm
button.secondary: inline-flex items-center justify-center border border-[#1E1E1E] text-[#1E1E1E] px-8 py-4 font-sans font-medium tracking-wide hover:bg-stone-100 transition-colors rounded-sm
button.ghost: inline-flex items-center justify-center text-[#1E1E1E] hover:text-[#C86A53] transition-colors font-medium

role_toggle.container: flex p-1 bg-stone-100 rounded-sm w-full max-w-sm mx-auto
role_toggle.button: flex-1 py-2 text-sm font-medium text-center transition-all relative z-10
role_toggle.active_indicator: absolute inset-0 bg-white shadow-sm rounded-[2px] z-0

property_card.wrapper: group relative flex flex-col bg-white border border-stone-200 overflow-hidden
property_card.image: w-full h-full object-cover transition-transform duration-700 group-hover:scale-105
property_card.title: font-sans font-medium text-lg text-[#1E1E1E] truncate
property_card.meta: flex items-center gap-4 text-sm text-stone-500 font-sans mt-2

inputs.default: w-full px-4 py-3 bg-stone-50 border border-stone-200 rounded-sm focus:outline-none focus:ring-0 focus:border-[#2C3D30] focus:bg-white transition-colors placeholder:text-stone-400 font-sans

libraries: framer-motion (for layout transitions, staggering, layoutId for role toggles)

hero.alt: Modern luxury house at golden hour with water pool
hero.placement: Landing Page Hero background or split-screen Auth left side.

property_interior_1.placement: Property Details Page Gallery or Featured Listings.

property_interior_2.alt: Sleek modern living room with dark tones

agent_or_lifestyle.placement: About Section or Inquiry Form context image.

iconography.style: Minimalist, stroke-width 1.5, avoiding heavily filled icons.
iconography.instructions: Use lucide-react. Do NOT use emojis for UI icons.

specific_page_instructions.landing_page: Use massive Typography (Cormorant) for the H1. The hero should not just be a dark overlay on an image. Consider an asymmetrical bento grid layout where the text takes up the left 5 columns on a #F7F5F0 background, and the hero image takes up the right 7 columns, spanning full height. Use Lenis for smooth scroll.
specific_page_instructions.listings_page: Implement a sticky sidebar for filters (Price, Beds, Baths, Type). The right side should be a CSS Grid of property cards. Animate cards in on scroll using framer-motion stagger.
specific_page_instructions.property_details: Hero section should be an immersive masonry gallery of images. Followed by a 2-column layout: Left column (7 cols) for Description & Amenities, Right column (5 cols) sticky card for Price & Inquiry form.
specific_page_instructions.auth_page: Split screen layout. Left side: immersive architectural photo (Hero image). Right side: Form. For the Admin/User switch, use a custom segmented control component with Framer Motion `layoutId` for the sliding pill effect. Store the active tab state explicitly.
specific_page_instructions.dashboards: Admin: High density, purely functional. Sidebar navigation (Dark Forest Green). Use Shadcn tables for listing management. User Dashboard: Focus on 'Saved Favorites' (Grid of cards) and 'Inquiries' (List view).

accessibility.contrast: Ensure white text on the #2C3D30 Primary background has sufficient contrast. The #1E1E1E text on #F7F5F0 is highly legible.
accessibility.motion: Wrap Framer Motion animations with a useReducedMotion check where necessary, or keep transitions subtle.
accessibility.testing: All interactive elements (buttons, toggles, form inputs, property cards) MUST have semantic `data-testid` attributes.

UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: You MUST use JavaScript (.js/.jsx) instead of TypeScript.
Do NOT use centered text-align globally. Only center headings when intentionally symmetric.
Do NOT use purple/violet gradients or 'AI slop' aesthetics. Stick to the Warm Brutalism palette defined here.
Ensure the header navigation is solid or glassmorphic (bg-white/80 + backdrop-blur) to prevent text collision over scrolling content.
Add 'data-testid' to ALL actionable UI pieces for testing.
Avoid Shadcn 'Card' wrapper for marketing pages if it forces rigid styles; use raw divs with the defined visual_enhancers for absolute control.
Implement Sonner for toast notifications (e.g., 'Inquiry Sent', 'Listing Added').
Images MUST NOT rely on placeholder services. Use the exact URLs provided in the `image_urls` section.
